value.text: Covert communication over classical [1]–[4] and classical-quantum channels [5]–[9] is governed by the SRL. For quantum covert communication, the authors' own prior work [10] (Anderson et al., 'Square root law for covert quantum communication over optical channels') found an SRL over the lossy thermal-noise bosonic channel. This paper shows achievability of the SRL over an arbitrary quantum channel.
